The three clinics

GOALS Psychology, Fortitude Valley. Yes: level access from the same-level car park, with free one-hour client parking in the centre. Sessions are fifty minutes and booked on the clinic’s Halaxy page. Some of its psychologists also visit homes, schools and community settings. Each profile shows the fee and Medicare position, and says so if a fee is not published.

Neutral Minds Psychology, Ashgrove. This is Jessica Katsamatsas’s practice. She works with neurodivergent adults in a neurodiversity-affirming, trauma-informed way, in Ashgrove and by telehealth Australia-wide.

Nurtured Thoughts Psychology, Graceville. Heather McAuliffe is a neurodivergent clinical psychologist who does neurodevelopmental assessment. Matthew Persello sees teens and adults, and Nzubechi Oguoma sees children, adults and families.

Assessment in Brisbane

Lachlan Avent and Meera Lakhani do ADHD and autism assessments at GOALS for children, teenagers and adults. Meera is an educational and developmental psychologist and also does cognitive assessments. Psychologists assess and diagnose but do not prescribe. For medication, see ADHD GP in Brisbane.

What it costs

Each psychologist sets their own fee, shown on their profile. With a Mental Health Treatment Plan from a GP, Medicare pays part of the fee for up to 10 sessions a year. At current rates the rebate is $101.55 a session for a registered psychologist and $149.05 for a clinical psychologist.

Who sees whom

Toddlers and early intervention: Lauren Poulos and Kate Row. Young people and families: Ellie Putland. Eating disorders and perinatal mental health: Samantha Courtney. Refugee and newly arrived clients: Alice Bui. Neurodivergent adults: Jessica Katsamatsas. The chips on The Network page show the same information.

Common questions

Where are the ADHD psychologists in Brisbane?

At GOALS Psychology in Fortitude Valley, which has level access and free client parking, Neutral Minds Psychology in Ashgrove, and Nurtured Thoughts Psychology in Graceville. All also offer telehealth.

Can I get an ADHD assessment from a psychologist in Brisbane?

Yes. Lachlan Avent and Meera Lakhani at GOALS Psychology assess ADHD and autism in children, teenagers and adults.

Is there parking at GOALS?

Yes. GOALS Psychology has level access from a same-level car park, with one hour of free client parking in the centre.

Do I need a referral?

No referral needed to book. To claim the Medicare rebate, you need a Mental Health Treatment Plan from a GP.
